title: Weeknote #2020
content:
Dave is doing important work here, holding Cadbury Heroes to account.

MacOS 27 broke the drivers for my thermal printer but thankfully someone made a new driver.

I'm on board with Spymarks, not watermarks.

The winners of the street photography awards are fantastic (obviously).

Side-eyeing projects like Una to try and get away from my Apple Watch at some point.

Hannah Fry's favourite fountain pens. Love this.

There's no world in which I can watch this documentary about Elon Musk but I'm glad it exists.

A gallery of control rooms on Flickr via SimpleBits.

While looking for an example of a Geordie accent, I came across this supercut of a "Geordie" character who has an accent that is so ridiculous I can't even work out what he thinks he's doing. They even brought in translator as a plot point. This whole thing is wild.

This monstrosity from Finn for the iPhone Duo.

Barstardica mixes different fonts into one for...reasons. I love and hate it.

This Tiny5 font is amazing and I need somewhere to use it as soon as possible.

Tyler has got me thinking about an old MacBook Pro we have at home with his post about repurposing a 15-Year-Old MacBook Air.

Lazygit is very nice but not something I have a need for.

littleFedi is a "small ActivityPub server written in Go". It's a single binary, designed to run on basically everything, and supports the Mastodon API.
